guitar.evidence: Jim Root has well-documented, long-running Fender signature models (Jim Root Telecaster and Stratocaster); Mick Thomson has a Jackson signature model. Both are well known in metal guitar gear circles.

tone.target: tight scooped nu-metal rhythm distortion with muted chugs
tone.profile: tight scooped nu-metal rhythm distortion with muted chugs
tone.summary: A highly aggressive and scooped signal chain utilizing a powerful distortion/fuzz stage followed by the Recti amp model into a 4x12 cabinet, optimized with a noise gate for maximum tightness.

rig.name: Slipknot - Wait And Bleed - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and noise inherent in high-gain rhythm playing.
Provide extra punch and drive to tighten the low end of the rhythm chugs.
blocks.gap: While an OD pedal might be used, a simple Boost is best for pure tightness without color.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core high-gain nu-metal distortion tone and scooped mids.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is used as a general high-gain platform, mimicking modern metal tones before the amp stage.

blocks.purpose: Provide the massive, scooped, modern high-gain foundation required for nu-metal.
Simulate a powerful modern cabinet suitable for aggressive rhythm tones.
blocks.gap: While UK Vintage 4x12 is an option, Mess 4x12 offers a more versatile and punchy platform for metal genres.

blocks.purpose: Aggressively scoop the mids and control the low-end frequencies for maximum tightness.
No wah effect needed; the focus is purely on aggressive rhythm and distortion.
Delay and reverb are avoided per the musical verdict.
Reverb is avoided per the musical verdict.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better definition in the low end.

proposals.reason: Enhance punch and clarity of modern metal chugs.
